controls.title: Maintain complete asset inventories
controls.statement: Maintain current inventories of hardware, software, IT and OT assets with the ownership, location, version and business context needed for security decisions.
controls.risk: Unknown or incorrectly recorded assets could remain unprotected, unsupported or connected after their business use has ended.
controls.scope: Enterprise hardware, software, virtual assets, cloud resources, network devices and operational technology.
controls.examine: Reconcile discovery, procurement, licensing, network and service records with hardware and software inventories and required attributes.
controls.interview: Ask asset owners how new, changed, temporary and retired assets are detected and how discrepancies are resolved.
controls.test: Sample assets from both the environment and the register and confirm bidirectional coverage, current attributes and assigned ownership.
test_steps: Select samples in both directions: assets observed through network, cloud, endpoint and procurement records, and assets listed in the authoritative inventories.
Reconcile each observed asset to a unique inventory record and each listed asset to a live, stored, retired or otherwise explained state.
Check required attributes such as owner, service, location, criticality, software or firmware, support status and last-seen time against authoritative sources.
Introduce or identify an authorised test asset and verify discovery, ownership assignment and inventory update occur within the defined interval.
controls.expected: In-scope assets appear in current inventories with enough accurate information to support risk, support and lifecycle decisions.

mappings.basis: Requires a detailed, accurate and current inventory of enterprise assets with specified attributes.
Requires a detailed inventory of licensed software with specified lifecycle and business information.
Requires a complete, accurate system-component inventory at defined granularity and periodic review.
Requires IT and OT inventory attributes that support cybersecurity activities.
Requires the IT and OT asset inventory to be updated periodically and on defined triggers.
Calls for an up-to-date asset register and controlled asset disposal.

controls.title: Maintain secure configuration baselines
controls.statement: Establish approved secure configuration baselines, use them for deployment and restoration, and monitor assets for unauthorised drift.
controls.risk: Inconsistent or weakened configurations could expose systems to attack and make reliable recovery harder.
controls.scope: Operating systems, applications, network devices, cloud services, firmware and OT configurations.
controls.examine: Inspect baseline standards, approvals, deployment records, configuration monitoring, deviations and baseline review history.
controls.interview: Ask platform owners how baselines are tested, updated and applied to legacy or constrained systems.
controls.test: Compare representative live and restored configurations with the approved baseline and verify that significant drift is detected.
test_steps: Select representative workstation, server, network, cloud and OT configurations and identify the approved baseline and version applicable to each.
Compare live settings with the baseline using an independent query or configuration-assessment tool, including security-relevant defaults and locally overridden values.
Make an authorised harmless deviation in a test environment and verify drift is detected, reported and routed to the responsible owner within the expected interval.
Restore the approved setting and confirm compliance status returns only after the live configuration has been rechecked.
controls.expected: Assets use approved current baselines, deviations are visible and authorised, and restoration returns assets to a known secure state.

mappings.basis: Requires a documented secure-configuration process for enterprise assets and software with annual review.
Requires a documented, current baseline configuration reviewed and updated under defined conditions.
Requires configuration baselines to be established.
Requires asset configurations to be monitored against baselines throughout their lifecycle.

controls.title: Authorise and verify changes
controls.statement: Evaluate, approve, document and test changes before release, with added scrutiny for changes to high-priority assets and security controls.
controls.risk: An unreviewed change could introduce a security weakness or outage with no reliable record of what changed or how to reverse it.
controls.scope: Configuration-controlled changes to applications, infrastructure, cloud services, firmware and OT assets.
controls.examine: Review change classifications, security impact analyses, approvals, test results, implementation records, rollback plans and post-change checks.
controls.interview: Ask change and asset owners how emergency work is controlled and when a change receives security review.
controls.test: Sample routine and emergency changes and trace each from request through approval, testing, implementation and verification.
test_steps: Select normal, high-risk, emergency, failed and rolled-back changes across representative technology and business services.
Trace each change through request, risk and security impact analysis, testing, approval, scheduled window, implementation identity and post-change verification.
Compare the approved components and commands with configuration and audit records to identify unapproved scope, timing or privilege.
For an authorised test change, verify monitoring detects the change, the success criteria are checked and the rollback procedure restores the prior state when invoked.
controls.expected: Changes are approved with security impact considered, tested where required, fully recorded and verified after implementation.

mappings.basis: Requires controlled change definition, security and privacy review, decision records, implementation, retention and oversight.
Requires asset changes to be evaluated and approved before implementation.
Requires changes to assets to be documented.
Requires changes to higher-priority assets to be tested before deployment.
